registerNotes: Friendly and extremely common in Spain in every informal setting; safe with the family.

senses.example: Vale, nos vemos a las ocho.

alternatives.reason: Formal equivalent; right for a shop assistant or a form, stiff with family.
Peninsular agreement/encouragement; slightly more energetic than vale.
Expresses approval, not agreement; a different reaction word.

notes: The single most characteristic Peninsular discourse marker; the learner will hear it daily in Pamplona.
